local View = {}

local function fontFace(weight)
	return Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/Montserrat.json", weight, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
end

local function applyShadow(guiObject)
	local ok, shadow = pcall(Instance.new, "UIShadow")
	if ok then
		shadow.Name = "Shadow"
		shadow.Color = Color3.fromRGB(4, 10, 20)
		shadow.Transparency = 0.42
		shadow.BlurRadius = UDim.new(0, 20)
		shadow.Offset = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 8)
		shadow.Parent = guiObject
		return shadow
	end
	return nil
end

local function makeCorner(parent, radius)
	local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
	c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)
	c.Parent = parent
	return c
end

local function makeStroke(parent, color, thickness, transparency)
	local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	s.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
	s.Color = color
	s.Thickness = thickness or 1
	s.Transparency = transparency or 0
	s.Parent = parent
	return s
end

local function makeGradient(parent, rotation, colors, transparency)
	local g = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	g.Rotation = rotation or 90
	g.Color = colors
	if transparency then
		g.Transparency = transparency
	end
	g.Parent = parent
	return g
end

local function createTextLabel(name, parent, text, size, weight, color, transparency)
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Name = name
	label.BackgroundTransparency = transparency == nil and 1 or transparency
	label.BorderSizePixel = 0
	label.Text = text
	label.TextColor3 = color
	label.TextTransparency = 0
	label.TextScaled = false
	label.TextWrapped = true
	label.RichText = false
	label.FontFace = fontFace(weight)
	label.TextSize = size
	label.ZIndex = 10
	label.Parent = parent
	return label
end

local function createIcon(name, parent, image, size, anchorPoint, position)
	local icon = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	icon.Name = name
	icon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	icon.BorderSizePixel = 0
	icon.Image = image
	icon.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	icon.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
	icon.Size = size
	icon.AnchorPoint = anchorPoint or Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
	icon.Position = position or UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)
	icon.ZIndex = 12
	icon.Parent = parent
	return icon
end

local function createButton(name, parent, buttonImage, sliceCenter, sliceScale, iconImage, text, isPrimary)
	local button = Instance.new("ImageButton")
	button.Name = name
	button.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	button.AutoButtonColor = false
	button.Image = buttonImage
	button.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	button.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Slice
	button.SliceCenter = Rect.new(sliceCenter[1], sliceCenter[2], sliceCenter[3], sliceCenter[4])
	button.SliceScale = sliceScale
	button.ZIndex = 5
	button.Parent = parent

	local shadow = Instance.new("Frame")
	shadow.Name = "ShadowPlate"
	shadow.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(7, 20, 43)
	shadow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45
	shadow.BorderSizePixel = 0
	shadow.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	shadow.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 10)
	shadow.Size = UDim2.new(0.94, 0, 0.78, 0)
	shadow.ZIndex = 4
	shadow.Parent = button
	makeCorner(shadow, isPrimary and 24 or 20)
	applyShadow(shadow)

	local visual = Instance.new("Frame")
	visual.Name = "Visual"
	visual.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	visual.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	visual.ZIndex = 6
	visual.Parent = button

	local gloss = Instance.new("Frame")
	gloss.Name = "Gloss"
	gloss.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	gloss.BackgroundTransparency = 0.82
	gloss.BorderSizePixel = 0
	gloss.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	gloss.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.07, 0)
	gloss.Size = UDim2.new(0.86, 0, 0.28, 0)
	gloss.ZIndex = 7
	gloss.Parent = visual
	makeCorner(gloss, 999)
	makeGradient(gloss, 90, ColorSequence.new({
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(173, 244, 255)),
	}), NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.15),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
	}))

	local rim = Instance.new("Frame")
	rim.Name = "InnerRim"
	rim.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	rim.Position = UDim2.new(0.04, 0, 0.08, 0)
	rim.Size = UDim2.new(0.92, 0, 0.84, 0)
	rim.ZIndex = 8
	rim.Parent = visual
	makeCorner(rim, isPrimary and 22 or 18)
	makeStroke(rim, Color3.fromRGB(242, 198, 109), 2, 0.35)

	local textLabel = createTextLabel("TextLabel", visual, text, isPrimary and 25 or 22, Enum.FontWeight.SemiBold, Color3.fromRGB(244, 251, 255))
	textLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	textLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -88, 1, 0)
	textLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 72, 0, 0)
	textLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	textLabel.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
	local textConstraint = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint")
	textConstraint.MinTextSize = 16
	textConstraint.MaxTextSize = isPrimary and 25 or 22
	textConstraint.Parent = textLabel

	createIcon(name .. "Icon", visual, iconImage, UDim2.fromOffset(30, 30), Vector2.new(0, 0.5), UDim2.new(0, 26, 0.5, 0))
	return button
end

	local plate = Instance.new("Frame")

	plate.BorderSizePixel = 0

		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(74, 223, 255)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.52, Color3.fromRGB(44, 98, 209)),

	applyShadow(plate)

	local trim = Instance.new("Frame")
	trim.Name = "Trim"
	trim.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	trim.Position = UDim2.new(0.025, 0, 0.12, 0)
	trim.Size = UDim2.new(0.95, 0, 0.76, 0)
	trim.ZIndex = 6
	trim.Parent = plate
	makeCorner(trim, 24)
	makeStroke(trim, Color3.fromRGB(242, 198, 109), 2, 0.15)

	local gloss = Instance.new("Frame")
	gloss.Name = "Gloss"
	gloss.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	gloss.BackgroundTransparency = 0.84
	gloss.BorderSizePixel = 0
	gloss.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	gloss.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.08, 0)
	gloss.Size = UDim2.new(0.84, 0, 0.28, 0)
	gloss.ZIndex = 7
	gloss.Parent = plate
	makeCorner(gloss, 999)

	local leftGem = Instance.new("Frame")
	leftGem.Name = "LeftGem"
	leftGem.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(242, 198, 109)
	leftGem.BorderSizePixel = 0
	leftGem.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18)
	leftGem.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	leftGem.Position = UDim2.new(0.08, 0, 0.5, 0)
	leftGem.Rotation = 45
	leftGem.ZIndex = 7
	leftGem.Parent = plate

	local rightGem = leftGem:Clone()
	rightGem.Name = "RightGem"
	rightGem.Position = UDim2.new(0.92, 0, 0.5, 0)
	rightGem.Parent = plate

	local title = createTextLabel("AuroraTitle", plate, "AURORA", 42, Enum.FontWeight.ExtraBold, Color3.fromRGB(244, 251, 255))
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -80, 1, 0)
	title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0, 0)
	title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	title.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
	local titleConstraint = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint")
	titleConstraint.MinTextSize = 22
	titleConstraint.MaxTextSize = 42
	titleConstraint.Parent = title

	return plate
end

local function createBackgroundOrnaments(parent)
	local ornaments = Instance.new("Frame")
	ornaments.Name = "BackgroundOrnaments"
	ornaments.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	ornaments.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	ornaments.ZIndex = 1
	ornaments.Parent = parent

	local function corner(name, xScale, yScale, flipX, flipY)
		local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
		holder.Name = name
		holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		holder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(170, 170)
		holder.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(xScale == 1 and 1 or 0, yScale == 1 and 1 or 0)
		holder.Position = UDim2.new(xScale, 0, yScale, 0)
		holder.ZIndex = 2
		holder.Parent = ornaments

		local lineA = Instance.new("Frame")
		lineA.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 129, 225)
		lineA.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
		lineA.BorderSizePixel = 0
		lineA.Size = UDim2.new(0, 120, 0, 4)
		lineA.Position = UDim2.new(0, flipX and 50 or 0, 0, flipY and 166 or 0)
		lineA.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
		lineA.Rotation = flipY and 180 or 0
		lineA.ZIndex = 2
		lineA.Parent = holder

		local lineB = Instance.new("Frame")
		lineB.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 129, 225)
		lineB.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
		lineB.BorderSizePixel = 0
		lineB.Size = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 120)
		lineB.Position = UDim2.new(0, flipX and 166 or 0, 0, flipY and 50 or 0)
		lineB.ZIndex = 2
		lineB.Parent = holder

		local gold = Instance.new("Frame")
		gold.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(242, 198, 109)
		gold.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
		gold.BorderSizePixel = 0
		gold.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16)
		gold.Rotation = 45
		gold.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		gold.Position = UDim2.new(0, flipX and 116 or 54, 0, flipY and 116 or 54)
		gold.ZIndex = 3
		gold.Parent = holder
	end

	corner("TopLeft", 0, 0, false, false)
	corner("TopRight", 1, 0, true, false)
	corner("BottomLeft", 0, 1, false, true)
	corner("BottomRight", 1, 1, true, true)

	return ornaments
end

local function createBackgroundRoot(parent)
	local bg = Instance.new("Frame")
	bg.Name = "BackgroundRoot"
	bg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8, 18, 31)
	bg.BorderSizePixel = 0
	bg.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	bg.Parent = parent

	makeGradient(bg, 90, ColorSequence.new({
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(12, 24, 40)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.45, Color3.fromRGB(8, 18, 31)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(4, 10, 20)),
	}))

	local bloom = Instance.new("Frame")
	bloom.Name = "Bloom"
	bloom.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(57, 213, 255)
	bloom.BackgroundTransparency = 0.88
	bloom.BorderSizePixel = 0
	bloom.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.35)
	bloom.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.3, 0)
	bloom.Size = UDim2.new(0.74, 0, 0.5, 0)
	bloom.ZIndex = 1
	bloom.Parent = bg
	makeCorner(bloom, 999)
	makeGradient(bloom, 0, ColorSequence.new({
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(30, 93, 200)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(57, 213, 255)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(30, 93, 200)),
	}), NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.65),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
	}))

	local bottomFade = Instance.new("Frame")
	bottomFade.Name = "BottomFade"
	bottomFade.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(4, 10, 20)
	bottomFade.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
	bottomFade.BorderSizePixel = 0
	bottomFade.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
	bottomFade.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)
	bottomFade.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.28, 0)
	bottomFade.ZIndex = 1
	bottomFade.Parent = bg
	makeGradient(bottomFade, 90, ColorSequence.new({
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(4, 10, 20)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(4, 10, 20)),
	}), NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.05),
	}))

	createBackgroundOrnaments(bg)
	return bg
end

local function createModal(name, parent, titleText, bodyText, closeName)
	local modal = Instance.new("CanvasGroup")
	modal.Name = name
	modal.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	modal.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	modal.GroupTransparency = 1
	modal.Visible = false
	modal.ZIndex = 30
	modal.Parent = parent

	local blocker = Instance.new("TextButton")
	blocker.Name = "Blocker"
	blocker.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(2, 7, 15)
	blocker.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
	blocker.BorderSizePixel = 0
	blocker.Text = ""
	blocker.AutoButtonColor = false
	blocker.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	blocker.ZIndex = 31
	blocker.Parent = modal

	panel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)

	panel.ZIndex = 32
	panel.Parent = modal
	makeCorner(panel, 24)
	makeStroke(panel, Color3.fromRGB(10, 35, 66), 5, 0)
	makeGradient(panel, 90, ColorSequence.new({
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(60, 178, 245)),

		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.7, Color3.fromRGB(17, 36, 61)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(12, 24, 40)),
	}))
	applyShadow(panel)

	local trim = Instance.new("Frame")
	trim.Name = "Trim"
	trim.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	trim.Position = UDim2.new(0.03, 0, 0.05, 0)
	trim.Size = UDim2.new(0.94, 0, 0.9, 0)
	trim.ZIndex = 33
	trim.Parent = panel
	makeCorner(trim, 20)
	makeStroke(trim, Color3.fromRGB(242, 198, 109), 2, 0.2)

	local cornerA = Instance.new("Frame")
	cornerA.Name = "CornerA"
	cornerA.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(242, 198, 109)
	cornerA.BorderSizePixel = 0
	cornerA.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14)

	cornerA.Rotation = 45

	cornerA.Parent = panel

	local cornerB = cornerA:Clone()

	cornerB.Position = UDim2.new(1, -32, 1, -32)
	cornerB.Parent = panel

	local title = createTextLabel(name == "CreditsModal" and "CreditsTitle" or "SettingsTitle", panel, titleText, 24, Enum.FontWeight.Bold, Color3.fromRGB(244, 251, 255))
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -100, 0, 34)
	title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 24, 0, 18)
	title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	title.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
	title.ZIndex = 35

	local closeButton = Instance.new("ImageButton")
	closeButton.Name = closeName
	closeButton.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	closeButton.AutoButtonColor = false
	closeButton.Image = "nexusasset://asset_c7c38ebbfb204596884f7b60988a3d6f"
	closeButton.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	closeButton.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Slice
	closeButton.SliceCenter = Rect.new(184, 185, 834, 839)
	closeButton.SliceScale = 0.2
	closeButton.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	closeButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -18, 0, 16)
	closeButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(50, 50)
	closeButton.ZIndex = 35
	closeButton.Parent = panel

	local closeVisual = Instance.new("Frame")
	closeVisual.Name = "Visual"
	closeVisual.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	closeVisual.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	closeVisual.ZIndex = 36
	closeVisual.Parent = closeButton
	createIcon(closeName .. "Icon", closeVisual, "nexusasset://asset_5faf258a5e6d409587d9b679f2343eea", UDim2.fromOffset(22, 22), Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0))

	if bodyText then
		local body = createTextLabel("CreditsBody", panel, bodyText, 17, Enum.FontWeight.Medium, Color3.fromRGB(184, 212, 232))
		body.Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 1, -82)
		body.Position = UDim2.new(0, 24, 0, 64)
		body.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		body.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top

	return modal, panel
end

	toggleAccent.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)

	local sliderTrack = Instance.new("Frame")

local function cancelModalTween(modal)
	if modalTweens[modal] then
		modalTweens[modal]:Cancel()
		modalTweens[modal] = nil
	end
end

local function getPanel(modal)
	return modal:FindFirstChild("Panel")
end

local function ensurePanelScale(panel)
	local scale = panel:FindFirstChild("ModalScale")
	if not scale then
		scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
		scale.Name = "ModalScale"
		scale.Scale = 1
		scale.Parent = panel
	end
	return scale
end

local function setModalVisible(modal, visible)
	local panel = getPanel(modal)
	if not panel then
		modal.Visible = visible
		if modal:IsA("CanvasGroup") then
			modal.GroupTransparency = visible and 0 or 1
		end
		return
	end

	cancelModalTween(modal)
	local scale = ensurePanelScale(panel)

	if visible then
		modal.Visible = true
		if modal:IsA("CanvasGroup") then
			modal.GroupTransparency = 1
		end
		scale.Scale = 0.96

		local tween = TweenService:Create(
			modal,
			TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
			{ GroupTransparency = 0 }
		)
		local scaleTween = TweenService:Create(
			scale,
			TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
			{ Scale = 1 }
		)
		modalTweens[modal] = tween
		tween:Play()
		scaleTween:Play()
	else
		local tween = TweenService:Create(
			modal,
			TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
			{ GroupTransparency = 1 }
		)
		local scaleTween = TweenService:Create(
			scale,
			TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
			{ Scale = 0.96 }
		)
		modalTweens[modal] = tween
		tween:Play()
		scaleTween:Play()
		addCleanup(tween.Completed:Connect(function()
			if modal.GroupTransparency >= 0.99 then
				modal.Visible = false
			end
		end))
	end
end

local function closeAllModals()
	for _, modal in ipairs(allModals) do

end

local function applyToggleVisual(toggle, enabled)
	local visual = toggle:FindFirstChild("Visual")
	if not visual then
		return
	end
	local fill = visual:FindFirstChild("ToggleFill")
	local thumb = visual:FindFirstChild("ToggleThumb")
	local accent = visual:FindFirstChild("ToggleAccent")
	local stateLabel = visual:FindFirstChild("StateLabel")

	if stateLabel and stateLabel:IsA("TextLabel") then
		stateLabel.Text = enabled and "ON" or "OFF"
		stateLabel.TextColor3 = enabled and Color3.fromRGB(244, 251, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(184, 212, 232)
	end

	if fill and fill:IsA("Frame") then
		fill.BackgroundColor3 = enabled and Color3.fromRGB(57, 213, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(39, 87, 186)
	end

	if accent and accent:IsA("Frame") then
		accent.Position = enabled and UDim2.new(0.2, 0, 0.5, 0) or UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0.5, 0)
		accent.BackgroundTransparency = enabled and 0.35 or 0.6
	end

	if thumb and thumb:IsA("Frame") then
		local target = enabled and UDim2.new(1, -(thumb.AbsoluteSize.X + 4), 0.5, 0) or UDim2.new(0, 4, 0.5, 0)
		local tween = TweenService:Create(thumb, TweenInfo.new(0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			Position = target,
			Size = thumb.Size,
		})
		tween:Play()
	end
end

local function sliderAlphaFromInput(slider, inputPositionX)
	local absolutePosition = slider.AbsolutePosition.X
	local absoluteSize = slider.AbsoluteSize.X
	if absoluteSize <= 0 then
		return state.volume
	end
	return (inputPositionX - absolutePosition) / absoluteSize
end

for _, slider in ipairs(allSliders) do
	local hit = slider:FindFirstChild("DragHitTarget")
	if hit and hit:IsA("GuiButton") then
		addCleanup(hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				activeDrag = slider
				updateAllSliders(math.clamp(sliderAlphaFromInput(slider, input.Position.X), 0, 1))
				local handle = slider:FindFirstChild("Handle")
				if handle and handle:IsA("Frame") then
					handle.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 32)
				end
			end
		end))

		addCleanup(hit.Activated:Connect(function()
			local position = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
			updateAllSliders(math.clamp(sliderAlphaFromInput(slider, position.X), 0, 1))
		end))
	end
end

addCleanup(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if not activeDrag then
		return
	end
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		updateAllSliders(math.clamp(sliderAlphaFromInput(activeDrag, input.Position.X), 0, 1))
	end
end))

addCleanup(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		if activeDrag then
			local handle = activeDrag:FindFirstChild("Handle")
			if handle and handle:IsA("Frame") then
				handle.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 26)
				if math.min(activeDrag.AbsoluteSize.X, activeDrag.AbsoluteSize.Y) > 40 then
					if handle.AbsoluteSize.X > 26 then
						handle.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 30)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		activeDrag = nil
	end
end))

local Responsive = {}
function Responsive.bind(root)
    local cameraConnection
    local connections = {}
    local function update()
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not camera then return end
        local size = camera.ViewportSize
        local mobile = math.min(size.X, size.Y) < 600
        for _, node in root:GetDescendants() do
            if node:IsA("GuiObject") then
                if node.Name == "_NexusDesktop" then node.Visible = not mobile end
                if node.Name == "_NexusMobile" then node.Visible = mobile end
            end
        end
    end
    local function observeCamera()
        if cameraConnection then cameraConnection:Disconnect() end
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if camera then cameraConnection = camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(update) end
        update()
    end
    table.insert(connections, workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(observeCamera))
    local function cleanup()
        if cameraConnection then cameraConnection:Disconnect() end
        for _, connection in connections do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(connections)
    end
    table.insert(connections, root.Destroying:Connect(cleanup))
    observeCamera()
    return cleanup
end
return Responsive

    local sounds = {}
    local originalAutoColor = button.AutoButtonColor
    button.AutoButtonColor = false
    local controller = {}
    bound[button] = controller
    local previousState = nil
    local hoverScale = math.clamp(tonumber(options.hoverScale) or 1.05, 1, 1.1)
    local pressScale = math.clamp(tonumber(options.pressScale) or 0.95, 0.85, 1)
    local duration = math.clamp(tonumber(options.duration) or 0.12, 0.06, 0.3)
    local shadow = options.shadow
    local shadowPosition = shadow and shadow.Position

    local function soundFor(kind, soundId)
        if type(soundId) ~= "string" or not soundId:match("^rbxassetid://%d+$") then return end
        local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
        sound.Name = "Feedback_" .. kind
        sound.SoundId = soundId
        sound.Volume = math.clamp(tonumber(options.volume) or 0.18, 0, 0.35)
        sound.Parent = button
        sounds[kind] = sound
    end
    soundFor("hover", options.hoverSound)
    soundFor("click", options.clickSound)

    local function playSound(kind)
        if not alive or not button.Interactable or options.sounds == false then return end
        local sound = sounds[kind]
        local now = os.clock()
        local delay = kind == "hover" and 0.12 or 0.08
        if not sound or now - lastSoundAt[kind] < delay then return end
        lastSoundAt[kind] = now
        sound.TimePosition = 0
        sound:Play()
    end

    local function pointerAvailable()
        return UserInputService.MouseEnabled
            and UserInputService:GetLastInputType() ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    end

    local function refresh()
        if not alive then return end
        local state = button.GuiState
        local target = 1
        if button.Interactable then
            if state == Enum.GuiState.Press then
                target = pressScale
            elseif (state == Enum.GuiState.Hover and pointerAvailable() and options.hoverEnabled ~= false) or focused then
                target = hoverScale
            end
        end
        if state == Enum.GuiState.Hover and previousState ~= state and pointerAvailable() and options.hoverEnabled ~= false then
            playSound("hover")
        end
        previousState = state
        if currentTween then
            currentTween:Cancel()
            currentTween = nil
        end
        if shadowTween then shadowTween:Cancel() end
        if GuiService.ReducedMotionEnabled or options.animations == false then
            scale.Scale = 1
            if shadow then shadow.Position = shadowPosition end
            return
        end
        currentTween = TweenService:Create(scale,
            TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            { Scale = target })
        currentTween:Play()
        if shadow then
            local offset = state == Enum.GuiState.Press and -2 or 0
            shadowTween = TweenService:Create(shadow, TweenInfo.new(duration),
                { Position = shadowPosition + UDim2.fromOffset(0, offset) })
            shadowTween:Play()
        end
    end

    connections[#connections + 1] = button
        :GetPropertyChangedSignal("GuiState"):Connect(refresh)
    connections[#connections + 1] = button
        :GetPropertyChangedSignal("Interactable"):Connect(refresh)
    connections[#connections + 1] = button.SelectionGained:Connect(function()
        focused = true
        refresh()
    end)
    connections[#connections + 1] = button.SelectionLost:Connect(function()
        focused = false
        refresh()
    end)
    connections[#connections + 1] = GuiService
        :GetPropertyChangedSignal("ReducedMotionEnabled"):Connect(refresh)
    connections[#connections + 1] = button.Activated:Connect(function()
        playSound("click")
    end)

    function controller:Destroy()
        if not alive then return end
        alive = false
        if currentTween then currentTween:Cancel() end
        if shadowTween then shadowTween:Cancel() end
        for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
        for _, sound in pairs(sounds) do sound:Destroy() end
        bound[button] = nil
        scale:Destroy()
        pcall(function() button.AutoButtonColor = originalAutoColor end)
        if shadow then pcall(function() shadow.Position = shadowPosition end) end
    end
    connections[#connections + 1] = button.Destroying:Connect(function()
        controller:Destroy()
    end)
    refresh()
    return controller
end

return ButtonFeedback
